run_upload_gtest: run upload_gtest.py to upload a Google Test patch for review with the mailing list cc'd
run_upload_gtest_with_cc: run upload_gtest.py with a custom --cc flag to add extra reviewers to the patch upload
run_upload_gtest_passthrough: run upload_gtest.py passing all upload.py options through to upload a patch
review_main: review the main function that wraps upload.py and auto-appends the gtest mailing list to cc
refactor_main: refactor the main function to support additional cc recipients or different upload scripts
